$description: Rhythm and structure rules a JSON Schema cannot express. Every rule id is enforced by schema/semantic_validate.py; verify_all.py checks the two agree.

rules.description: A PageSpec's nodes must equal its declared template's node list in order. Template nodes are all required and non-repeatable (no optionality was observed in the source).
PageSpec.route must be one of the declared template's routes (or match its CMS routePattern with a real CMS slug).
A section may only appear in templates listed in its contract's allowedTemplates (derived from the IA matrix).
chrome.navbar is the first node on every template that has chrome and absent on templates that have none.
chrome.footer is the last node on every template that has chrome and absent on templates that have none.
Navbar variant (desktop), navbar content.phoneVariant and footer variant must equal the per-route table measured in src/chrome.js (stored in templates/routes.json).
At most one HERO-category section per page, except the named templates below that contain more than one. Templates with zero heroes are listed in noHeroTemplates.
Avoid two adjacent non-chrome sections of one category, except the adjacent pairs that occur in the real templates.
No two adjacent nodes may both declare the scroll-linked motion pattern.
A page may declare scroll-linked motion on at most 2 nodes (the most any real template allows by its sections' evidenced patterns).

Every node.motion declares reducedMotionFallback and it must equal the fallback mapped to its pattern. NOTE: the source site/clone contains no reduced-motion handling (grep for useReducedMotion / prefers-reduced-motion returns nothing); this rule is a generation-time contract added by the design-repo, not an observed behaviour.

No string anywhere in a PageSpec may contain http(s)://, mailto: or a protocol-relative URL. The clone removes outbound links (external anchors are rendered as buttons) and its forms do not submit anywhere.

media[].assetRole must be allowed for the section. Roles whose policy is must-reuse-exact or must-not-fabricate require assetRef to be one of that role's registered files (pinned-value check) and must not carry generationBrief; may-generate-new roles require generationBrief and must not carry assetRef. Roles with no registered files cannot be referenced.
On blog-post / video-post pages any content.post reference must name the collection and slug of the page's own route.
Every string field carrying maxWords in its section contract must not exceed it.
